preconditions.expression: t == int(stdin.split()[0]) and t >= 1 and t <= 100
preconditions.description: The first line of input is the number of test cases t, where 1 ≤ t ≤ 100.
Each test case starts with a line containing two integers n and m (1 ≤ n, m ≤ 2e5), representing the grid dimensions.

preconditions.expression: all(len(row.split()) == m for row in stdin.splitlines()[2:2+n])
preconditions.description: Each of the next n lines contains exactly m integers, representing the grid cells (1 ≤ a_{i,j} ≤ 1e9).

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(num) <= 1e9 for row in stdin.splitlines()[2:2+n] for num in row.split())
preconditions.description: Each cell value a_{i,j} is a positive integer between 1 and 1e9.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == '-1' or (stdout.strip().count(' ') == 1 and all(1 <= int(x) <= m for x in stdout.strip().split()))
postconditions.description: If no valid swap exists, output '-1'. Otherwise, output two integers i and j (1 ≤ i, j ≤ m) representing the columns to swap.

postconditions.expression: all(all(int(row[j]) >= int(row[j-1]) for j in range(1, m)) for row in [stdin.splitlines()[i+1] for i in range(0, t*2, 2)]) if stdout.strip() != '-1' else True
postconditions.description: If a swap is output, the grid must be good after swapping columns i and j (i.e., each row is non-decreasing).
